editorial:
Get ready for a wild ride to the red planet in this animated adventure. When young Milo's mom gets snatched by Martians, he sneaks aboard their ship and ends up on Mars, where he teams up with a goofy human named Gribble who has been stuck there for years. Together they race against time to save Milo's mom before the Martians drain her "mom-ness" to raise their own babies. The movie has a fun, fast-paced vibe with lots of action and heart, though the motion-capture animation can look a little uncanny at times. It's a sweet story about appreciating your parents.

The voice cast does solid work, and the action scenes keep things moving. The emotional core about family and sacrifice lands well, even if the humor is hit or miss. Some younger kids might find the Martian villains a bit scary. If you're in the mood for a family-friendly sci-fi adventure, this one is worth a look. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Milo and Gribble reach the extraction chamber just in time to stop the machine from killing Milo's mom. The twist reveals that the Martian babies were separated from their own mothers, who were banished to the trash pits below. Milo helps reunite the Martian moms with their children, and the cruel Supervisor is overthrown. Milo and his mom escape back to Earth, while Gribble finally gets to go home too. Milo returns with a new appreciation for his mom.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventures and animated sci-fi stories.
